hero.title: Axopar 29 XC Cross Cabin
hero.heading: Axopar 29 XC Cross Cabin
hero.subheading: Choose Nothing But the Awards Winning Boat
hero.intro: The Axopar 29 XC Cross Cabin is a fully enclosed walk-around adventure boat designed to perform in every climate. It offers the protection you need in northern winters and the freedom to enjoy warm summer cruising without compromise. Practical layouts, quick boarding, smart storage, and effortless day-to-day usability make it a true low-threshold boat that gets you on the water faster.

sections.title: More Hydrodynamic
sections.intro: Together with improved hydrodynamics, the bigger 400 liter fuel tank offers a cruising range of 200+ nautical miles, and a wide cruising speed zone between 22 to 32 knots where liters per nautical mile consumption remain almost unchanged. The new hull dynamics also raise the fast-cruising speed of the Axopar 29´s up towards 37 knots, still maintaining good fuel efficiency and driving comfort.

sections.title: More Design
sections.intro: A bold new design language combines a higher bow flair for added protection with wider walkaround side decks for effortless movement. Sliding cabin doors are taller and wider for improved accessibility, while full-width wraparound glazing in the Cross Cabin model delivers exceptional visibility.

sections.title: More Lounging
sections.intro:
The new layout on the foredeck provides so much more volume in the bow, and you can now comfortably seat up to 8 people. Such is the sense of space that when you're looking forward from the helm you could almost imagine yourself being on the Axopar 37.
Adding the optional U-sofa extension, together with the front-facing bench, creates a kind of new O-shaped lounging area, which is great for socializing. A hi-lo table can be used for drinks and al fresco eating, and infill cushions offer the option of a huge sunbed.

sections.title: Welcome to the Hull of Fame
sections.intro:
Every Axopar begins where the boating experience truly begins: below the waterline. Many boaters have learned to accept certain compromises as normal. Our hull-first approach gets the fundamentals right from the start. Since the first Axopar 28 was launched in 2014, this philosophy has shaped our multi-award-winning range, helped create the adventure boating category, and contributed to more than 7,600 Axopar boats being sold worldwide.

Discover the Hull of Fame and the engineering behind the distinctive Axopar driving experience.

items.name: Driver Experience
items.title: Driver Experience
items.text:
Step inside a pilothouse designed for freedom of movement. Fewer thresholds, generous legroom for both front and rear passengers, and increased headroom create a truly open feel.

The optimized layout and improved sightlines, paired with wraparound panoramic windscreens, deliver a bright, airy atmosphere and exceptional 360° visibility. Every journey feels more connected and enjoyable.

items.name: Panorama View
items.title: Panorama View
items.text: The C-pillars have been repositioned further forward, reducing blind spots and improving rearward visibility. This adjustment makes reversing and mooring in confined spaces significantly safer and more precise.

items.name: Multi-cabin
items.title: Multi-cabin
items.text: The multi-cabin adds significant functionality to the boat. It serves as a spacious storage compartment by default, and can be optionally equipped with a toilet and sink. Additional mattresses can also be added to create overnight accommodation for two people, without reducing the usable space on the aft deck.

items.name: Safe to Move Around
items.title: Safe and Convenient Boarding
items.text: Integrated steps combined with handrails throughout the boat ensure easy and secure access. A step-free walkaround deck and strategically placed anti-skid surfaces on the bulwarks provide additional safety when moving around.

items.name: Spacious Bathing Platforms
items.title: Spacious Bathing Platforms
items.text: Generously sized bathing platforms make boarding straightforward from any angle. Opting for the single-engine configuration maximizes available deck space, creating larger platforms for improved usability and freedom of movement.

items.name: Space Utilization
items.title: Space Utilization
items.text: Through innovative design, the interior layout has been carefully optimized to maximize functionality in limited areas. This approach provides increased storage capacity and more efficient onboard solutions throughout the 29-range.

items.name: Modular Fore Deck
items.title: Modular Fore Deck
items.text: The modular nature of the 29 range extends to the fore deck as well. With new layout options such as a u-sofa and forward-facing sun beds, you can enjoy lounging in even more ways than before.

items.name: Further Improved Aft Cabin
items.title: Further Improved Aft Cabin
items.text: The practical aft-cabin doubles as a huge ‘multi-storage’ space for transporting gear and equipment, and for easy loading there is now a wide-opening hatch so that all kinds of gear, including wakeboards and water skis etc, can be accessed easily and safely stowed from the aft deck.

items.name: Fridge and Sink
items.title: Fridge & Sink
items.text: To make your home away from home feel even more like home, you can choose the optional top-loading fridge and sink, so you can have an ice-cool beverage and some snacks, all while taking in the scenery.

items.name: Light in the Dark
items.title: Light in the Dark
items.text: The hardtop allows for the addition of a forward-facing 10000+ lumens light bar for low-light conditions. The CCX can also be specified with downward-facing flood lights directed onto the fore and aft decks. Together, these lights form the work lights option.

items.name: Fishbox with Macerator
items.title: Fishbox with Macerator
items.text: Conveniently integrated into the optional bow U-sofa extension, this insulated storage compartment holds up to 74 liters (19 gallons) of bait or catch. The integrated macerator pump and overboard drainage system allow quick flushing and hassle-free water removal, while the insulated construction helps keep temperatures cooler longer on extended trips.

items.caption: With tremendous sightlines, 360 panoramic views, and an uncluttered helm, the Axopar 29 XC Cross Cabin provides an exceptional driving experience.
Thanks to large sliding side doors, and keeping the level differences to a minimum, the pilothouse enables ease of movement in and out, and down to the optional aft cabin.
The optional U-Sofa configuration on the fore deck is an inviting area for both lounging and dining
The optional Aft Cabin gives the long-haul adventurers the possibility to comfortably sleep two people on extended adventures.

sections.title: Alternatives for Aft Deck
sections.intro: The modular nature of Axopars and our multi-platform approach enable you to customize your boat with an aft layout that suits your everyday needs. As standard, the Axopar 29 XC Cross Cabin comes with a spacious open aft deck. The aft deck can also be equipped with an optional Aft Deck Bench, Wet Bar, or Aft Cabin / Multi Storage Compartment.

sections.title: Configurations & Layouts
sections.intro: We want to provide you with an extensively customizable, user-friendly boat that meets your everyday needs year-round and supports all your adventures. The configuration you choose will define the final layout of your boat. Below are a few examples of exterior and interior layouts available.

items.title: Open Aft
items.text: with optional Silvertex Hunter Upholstery and Forward Facing Sun Lounge in the bow.

items.title: Aft Deck Bench
items.text: with optional Silvertex Squash upholstery, Fenderbox Wet Bar, L-Sofa with Table in bow.

items.title: Wet Bar
items.text: with optional Linetex Sphere upholstery, U-Sofa with Table in bow.

items.title: Aft Cabin / Multi Storage Compartment
items.text: with standard Petrol Upholstery, Fenderbox Wet Bar, Sun Lounge in bow.

items.title: Aft Cabin / Multi Storage Compartment
items.text: optional Mediterrana Edition, Mediterrana Soft Decking, Sun Lounge in bow.

sections.title: Upgrade Options
sections.intro: Elevate your Axopar 29 with the stylish BRABUS Line for a refined, premium look and feel, or choose the BRABUS Performance Line for extra power and exhilarating speed. Further express yourself with the BRABUS Line Color Upgrade. For those who value ultimate comfort, the Mediterrana Edition creates a luxurious onboard experience, perfect for lounging and entertaining.

items.title: BRABUS Line Color Edition
modal_text: For style-conscious customers looking to make their Axopar 29 truly stand out, the Brabus Line Color Edition introduces four striking hull colors: the vibrant, playful Miami Blue; the more subtle, sophisticated Platinum Grey. The fresh, contemporary Glacier Blue; and the timeless, elegant Pearl White These duo-tone color options combine colored areas with uncolored sections in standard white finish, giving the boat a dynamic and distinctive look.

items.title: BRABUS PERFORMANCE LINE
modal_text: The BRABUS Performance Line features stylish hull and roof graphics and an extra boost of power on the transom, courtesy of Twin Mercury Verado V8 250hp DTS engines, to get you to your adventure destination promptly.

items.title: MEDITERRANA EDITION
modal_text:
Designed for those who enjoy lounging, socializing, or cruising in the sun, the Mediterrana Edition enhances onboard comfort and sophistication without compromising functionality. Luxurious features include thicker, plush, more refined cushions in a sophisticated beige tone. The upholstery’s structured texture and patterns not only exude style but also keep lounging areas cool and comfortable, even on the sunniest days.

Elegant bamboo trays and cup holders, and warm-toned interior finishes create an inviting, cozy atmosphere. Beige fabric wall panels and bamboo technical panels further enhance the sophisticated look and feel of the lounging areas.

standard_equipment.name: Wheelhouse / Cockpit
standard_equipment.description:
- Fully enclosed cabin with sliding doors.
- Manually opening canvas roof with harbor cover.
- Integrated windscreen wipers.
- Light mast, anchor light & horn on roof.
- Pilot and co-pilot seats with flip-up bolster on rotating and sliding swivels, color: Silvertex Petrol.
- Foldable aft sofa with cushions and storage behind.
- 6x recessed led roof lights,
- Usb oultets at helm and aft sofa.
- Roof panels in vintage steel fabric.
- Carpet in grey.
- Fire & CO alarms.
- Grab rails in roof and on console.
- Wooden grab handles and cupholders on both sides of the aft sofa.
- Clean helm layout with control switch panel in glass with illuminated buttons.
- Steering wheel in leather with Axopar logo.

standard_equipment.name: General
standard_equipment.description:
- Hand laminated, twin-stepped hull in Vinyl ester resin for the first coat for osmosis prevention.
- Stiffer and more rigid construction compared to previous models.
- Reduced weight by optimized glass fiber layup.
- All PVC sandwich material is replaced by PET recycled materials.
- No plywood used for constructural purposes.
- Hull design with “sharp entry bow” and integrated engine brackets.
- Sound insulated hull.
- Grey rub rail with rubber end caps.
- Axopar 3D signature chrome logo on both sides of hull.
- Bow thruster tunnel preparation.
- Walk-around deck layout with open aft deck
- Anti-skid finishing on self-draining working deck.
- L-sofa bench in bow area with storage space underneath.
- All pulpits, side rails, locks, hinges, filler caps & cockpit grab rails in 316 stainless steel.
- 6x cleats around deck.
- LED Navigation lights.
- Hooking points for safety harness around side deck areas.
- Pulpits on fore deck.
- Anchor box.
- Twin large fender storages on aft deck.
- Battery / electrical compartment under aft deck storage.
- Flagpole.
- Fixed 400l fuel tank with level sensor.
- 2x electric auto bilge pumps and 2x manual bilge pumps.

standard_equipment.name: Front Cabin
standard_equipment.description:
- Storage space with skylight and mirror.
- Main fuse panel with automatic fuses.
- 12V USB outlet.
- Fire & CO alarms.
- 2x roof spotlights.
- Ventilation grills.
